audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1-3 were scored Skill / Gangplank / Gangplank in both layers while every prose line for those rows describes Lucian winning.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Lucian, Lucian, Skill for rows 0-2, and the already-audited mirror (gangplank__lucian) was brought onto that same chart. Leaving our side inverted would contradict the mirror outright.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 flipped as one atomic group across phases[N].side and win[N], with ratings inverted. whys[0..2] already matched and needed no change.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was described as a global R 'plus a chained barrel-knockup'.
audit.why: Cannon Barrage is 160/140/120s, effectively unlimited range, and deals TRUE damage with a slow. Powder Keg slows — it has no knockup. The true damage is the point that matters and was never stated.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text and whys[4] rebuilt on the real cooldown and the true-damage property.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places claimed Powder Keg knocks up.
audit.why: Riot's text for Powder Keg: it explodes, spreading the attack's damage and SLOWING enemies. No displacement. A player told to expect a knockup will hold E for CC that never arrives.
audit.corrected: mid, spikes[2].text, whys[4] and wants.you[2] now say slow. Also fixed the fabricated 'Your Culling' to the real name, The Culling.

audit.why: Remove Scurvy both cleanses and heals (22/20/18/16/14s), so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades. report[8].t already carries 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain'.
audit.corrected: Reinforced in late so the buy has a stated reason.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Kegs are stacked now — your string still chunks him, but a chained detonation answers it. Trade on keg downtime only.

edits.before: Your Culling is a burst spike but he answers with W cleanse, the heal, and a barrel knockup — it is even, not a takeover.
edits.after: The Culling is a burst spike but Cannon Barrage answers it — true damage straight through resistances, plus a keg slow you cannot outrun.

edits.before: His R global plus a chained barrel-knockup is the wave you fear — track his ult cooldown before you ever sidelane.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage is global on a 160s cooldown and deals true damage — track that timer before you ever sidelane alone.

edits.before: Use W's move-speed proc and E dash to weave out of barrel-chain knockup range
edits.after: Use W's move-speed proc and E dash to leave the keg slow and chain radius

edits.before: This is where it slips. Once Gangplank has a few barrel stacks and W (Remove Scurvy) up, he cleanses your slows, eats a citrus heal mid-trade, and chains a barrel knockup that locks your low HP before E is back. Keep using W's marked move-speed proc and your E dash to stay out of detonation radius, and never facecheck a primed barrel. At 6 your Culling is a damage spike, not a lane-shift — and his global R plus barrel wave can collapse on you, so don't overstay a shove.
edits.after: This is where it slips. Once Gangplank has kegs stacked and W (Remove Scurvy) up, he cleanses your slows, eats a citrus heal mid-trade, and chains a detonation whose slow pins your low HP before E is back — kegs slow, they never knock up. Keep W's marked move-speed proc and your E dash outside the blast radius, and shoot a fresh keg before it primes. At 6 The Culling is a damage spike, not a lane-shift — his global R plus a keg chain can collapse on you, so don't overstay a shove.

edits.before: You lose the late outright. Gangplank is a hard scaler — Trinity Force, Essence Reaver, and crit make a single chained barrel one-shot you, and his W heal plus passive sustain outlast your DPS. Your Culling channel does nothing into his constant repositioning and barrel zoning. If you didn't convert levels 2-3 into a real lead, shove, roam, and let your team answer his split — you cannot out-trade an itemized Gangplank.
edits.after: You lose the late outright. Gangplank is a hard scaler — Trinity Force, Essence Reaver, and crit make a single chained keg one-shot you, and Remove Scurvy on a 14s cooldown plus passive sustain outlast your DPS unless you bought Grievous Wounds. The Culling does nothing into his repositioning and keg zoning. If you didn't convert levels 1-2 into a real lead, shove, roam, and let your team answer his split.

notes: Rows 0-2 were enum-only errors — the prose was already right and only side/win were inverted, which is exactly the two-layer disagreement the regression check blocks. 'Your Culling' (flagged in suspectNames) corrected to The Culling in both whys[4] and late. Powder Keg knockup was fabricated in four places and is now removed everywhere it appeared in writable text.
